metadata.title: Carboplatin AUC 2 Weekly with Radiotherapy
metadata.indication: Concurrent chemoradiation for stage III–IV locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (00419a) or locally advanced cervical cancer (00419b), where cisplatin is contraindicated or not tolerated.

indications.description: Concurrent chemoradiation for locally advanced cervical cancer where cisplatin is contraindicated or not tolerated.
Concurrent chemoradiation for stage III–IV locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma where cisplatin is contraindicated or not tolerated.

treatment.schedule_summary: Carboplatin AUC 2 IV over 30 minutes on day 1 every 7 days for 6 doses, only concurrently with radiotherapy.
treatment.duration_text: 6 weekly carboplatin doses only while receiving concurrent radiotherapy; stop carboplatin if radiotherapy is truncated.
administration_notes: Calvert dose in mg = target AUC × (absolute GFR in mL/min + 25); cap GFR at 125 mL/min. Measured GFR is preferred; verify estimates in obesity or low creatinine.
250 mL glucose 5% over 30 minutes. Do not continue carboplatin independently if radiotherapy is truncated.

Source p1 links head-and-neck treatment to adjuvant 00552 four weeks after radiotherapy, but 00552 is specifically nasopharyngeal. Confirm diagnosis and the separately authorised adjuvant plan; do not automatically assign 00552 to every head-and-neck squamous carcinoma.

action.message: Carboplatin hypersensitivity is a source exclusion. A prior mild reaction may exceptionally be considered for rechallenge only with immunology advice, premedication and a controlled desensitisation protocol with resuscitation and medical/ITU/HDU supervision. This assessment does not authorise rechallenge.

action.message: Cap absolute GFR at 125 mL/min in the Calvert calculation. Verify the renal value and prescribed dose; do not calculate from an uncapped higher GFR.

action.message: Calvert dosing requires verified absolute GFR/CrCl in mL/min. An indexed eGFR or unknown renal method is not accepted unchanged.

action.message: For Cockcroft–Gault/Wright dosing, verify creatinine sampled within 48 hours and recalculate as required each cycle before administering carboplatin. Missing timing does not prove freshness.

source.implementation_note: Authored safety hold until the source sampling requirement is confirmed.

rules.explanation: For Cockcroft–Gault/Wright dosing, verify creatinine sampled within 48 hours and recalculate as required each cycle before administering carboplatin. Missing timing does not prove freshness.

action.message: Current creatinine exceeds 110% of the value at isotope GFR. Consider remeasuring GFR or recalculating by Cockcroft–Gault/Wright before carrying forward the dose; no automatic dose is provided.

action.message: Compare current creatinine with the value at isotope GFR before retaining the previous dose. Missing comparison does not establish stability.

action.message: Measured GFR is preferred when obesity or low serum creatinine makes an estimate unreliable. Confirm weight and creatinine method; do not silently apply an adjustment or creatinine floor.

eligibility: Indication as specified in the current source
Carboplatin only while radiotherapy is delivered concurrently
exclusions: Prior mild carboplatin hypersensitivity is only an exceptional specialist desensitisation consideration; no routine rechallenge is authorised

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00419 v6 p4: moderate emetogenic potential. No distinct low-risk maintenance phase is defined.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for moderate emetogenic risk
supportive_care.premedications: Usually no specific premedication is required by this source; use local antiemetic policy. This does not replace any exceptional hypersensitivity/desensitisation plan.
monitoring_notes: FBC, renal and hepatic profile at baseline and before each weekly cycle.
Measured isotope GFR preferred; source-approved absolute estimate if used.
Regular neurological and hearing assessment, with baseline audiology/neuropathy evaluation as clinically indicated.
Disease monitoring according to the individual Consultant treatment plan.
